steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Tsk... Those are the same goons as last time— How'd they find us here?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Hurry up and retreat! Don't waste time!

steps.name: W
steps.text: They've got us surrounded. And outnumbered.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Then we gotta find a way to break through!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Their scouts took out all our sentries. We're in the dark here...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Bullshit! Are you gonna stand around and wait for their Casters to fry you?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Hey, you... You're with Hoederer... What are you doing here?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Where's Hoederer? And his men? He's supposed to be—

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Wh-what are you doing to my comms?! What gives—!

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Would you shut up already?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Remember how I was on patrol here? That made it real easy to plant bombs all over your camp.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...You! Hoederer! You sold us out...!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't make it sound so bad.

steps.name: W
steps.text: We're headed out on a long, long trip. And wouldn't you know it? Some guests showed up just as we're leaving. So someone's gotta stay behind to hold the fort.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Now if we leave some snacks out for our guests like a good host, maybe that'll get them to stop chasing us?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Gotta say, I appreciate all you're doing for us~

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Damn you... You knew they were coming the whole time... And you're just going to leave us here to die—?!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hmmm...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Well, at least try to put up a bit of a fight. The more you struggle, the bigger our head start.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But seriously, thanks a kiloton.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I ordered you to help the teams that didn't have time to escape, but...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Why didn't anyone else make it out?

steps.name: W
steps.text: They volunteered to stay behind.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't worry. I left them a little gift... So they were more than happy to help us hold off the bad guys.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...I doubt anyone here would be willing to sacrifice themselves.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: No need to lie about it. Nobody's going to blame you for sacrificing others to save your own squad.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But lying to your commander is another story.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You can't fool my eyes, W. You're on thin ice here.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Don't forget how green you are.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...I'll be sure to reflect upon my actions, Captain Ines.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Because we'll be working together... for a very long time.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: So, what's the plan now?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: No harm, no foul. What's done is done, and it was probably going to turn out like this anyway.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: W might have made the right call.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Do you seriously believe that?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The Sarkaz over there have nothing to do with us.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Who they were, what they did. How they lived, how they died. None of our business.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Brutal.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Let's talk work first. Ines, you and W split up and lead your teams away. Messengers stay radio silent, then regroup at the rendezvous point.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...I'll catch up later.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...One more thing.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I don't care what kind of mischief you get up to, how one of you exploits the other or whatever, but I won't stand for you actually, directly fighting.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But indirectly is fine?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Pretty lax rules.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I really hope it doesn't come to that. But it's not like I could stop it either.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: For now, at least, if you plan to stay alive, make good use of every last Sarkaz you have.
Hoederer has always been like this.
He thinks very little about what actually matters, and wastes so much brainpower on the pointless stuff.
...Nobody says W isn't a great fighter. But there's a lot she's missing.
If she really is just an incredible Sarkaz warrior...
....Hmph.

steps.name: W
steps.text: It's not even dark out. And you still gotta hide over here by the fire?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Maybe you just like fire?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I definitely don't like people bothering me.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Your team is three hours late.

steps.name: W
steps.text: That ambush... did you and Hoederer plan that?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Go ask him.

steps.name: W
steps.text: He doesn't know anything about it.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Then it must've been a coincidence. All mercs are a pain in the ass to deal with. You cross their path, and they're gonna give you shit.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh, that's all? Here I was worried Hoederer sold out my position.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You think that's what he should've done?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: How do you know we're not lying to you?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You could've killed me a long time ago. Doing it now wouldn't help much, would it?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What were you doing before you found us?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Huh? After all we've been through, you're giving me the job interview now?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hoederer never asks about his people's pasts. But I'm not Hoederer.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Yeah you're a whole different species from us.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Are you looking for trouble here?

steps.name: W
steps.text: As far as I can tell, 'Miss Ines' isn't so good at close combat.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: A lesson for you: If you want to live a little longer, don't put all your eggs in one basket.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Every Sarkaz mercenary carries a sword.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Well color me surprised. All this time I thought that was your staff. But...

steps.name: W
steps.text: —Oh, but you, a 'Sarkaz mercenary?'

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: —Tch...

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm still pretty sure I've got you beat at close range, but... Hmm, I admit I got a little careless.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Well, thanks. A scratch on the arm is a pretty cheap price for that lesson.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You and Hoederer are both pretty good at keeping your cards close to your chest.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I'd rather talk about you. High-profile mercenaries like you are pretty much all dead by now.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You've made such big waves in such a short time, but I never heard anything about you before you joined us. That's pretty suspicious.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: And you came looking for Hoederer. Why?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You said it yourself.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What?

steps.name: W
steps.text: A lot of people in Kazdel are after his head.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You dropped that bomb pretty smoothly. Why'd you change your mind?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hmm... I figured I'd get what I want easier this way.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: And what is it you want?

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...None of your business.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You're shook. How funny. Why not make something up to dodge the question?

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Your Arts again?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Those damned eyes. My reasons have nothing to do with you.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Same with my eyes.

steps.name: W
steps.text: What was that?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...From the east. Something's coming.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: There's more than one squad, but only one of them's the real deal. Hmph, they sure are cautious...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ehh, sounds like a pretty big gang. Just how many people did they hire?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Hoederer was right. This is going to be our biggest battle yet.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: We're heading into uncharted territory now.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You scared?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hoederer should be here soon with his squad. Tell the Messenger to get back on comms.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I don't remember anyone putting you in charge. Don't give me orders.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oooh, whoopsie...

steps.name: W
steps.text: You just keep guarding this campfire over here. I'll head down to the camp and check on the situation.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: That's... Babel's...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Sorry, had to take a little detour along the way. Ended up wasting a bit of time.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But it's time for us to really get to work now.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Positions, everyone.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Hm... And how you doing over there?

steps.name: W
steps.text: A-okay.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Judging from the burnt grass and neatly-cleaved mud here, you two have been busy.

steps.name: W
steps.text: C'mon, we were just sparring a little, as a warm up. Definitely not fighting or anything.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Right?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Don't worry. Next time, I'll bury you where they'll never find your body.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Just to reiterate, our job is simple. Don't let anyone near our mark.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Eliminate anything in the canyon that looks at you sideways. Open fire on anyone who approaches.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Any questions?

steps.name: W
steps.text: So, where's our destination?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Can't disclose that. This escort task is to be carried out in stages, and our mapped route has already been passed out. After we reach our destination in three days, someone will connect with us.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Hoederer.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What are they transporting?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I also can't— Wait, Ines.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: It's a breach of contract to use your Arts to probe the transport team. Don't underestimate them! Stop right now!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You said they were a regular old transport team—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I... no, this is definitely a convoy that needs protection.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But this huge thing that they're transporting... I'm only seeing a shadow...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...A landship? No, it's...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...a skeleton?
